claims.verbatim:
Steamship Kangaroo (Br), Manning, Liverpool June 9, via
Queenstown 10th, with mdse and 554 passengers, to John G
Dale. June 18, lat 46 19, lon 41 36, passed ship Kenilworth
(Br), from Hamburg for New York; 19th, lat 44 40, lon 46 26,
steamship Edinburg, hence for Liverpool; 21st, lat 43 05, lon
56 50, ship American Congress, from London for New York;
22d, lat 42 09, lon 61 48, a brig rigged steamer bound E.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted lat. 50 50, long. 20 36 (23d 2 p. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Boston, Brooks, Liverpool June 20, and Queens-
town 21st, with mdse. and 734 pass. to John G. Dale. June 20, 4:35 p.
m., off Ormes's Head, passed steamship City of Cork; 21st, 4 a. m.,
20[?] miles N. E.[?] of Tuskar, passed steamship City of Paris, bound up;
23d, 2 p. m., lat. 50 50, long. 20 36, Edinburgh, bound E; 24th at noon,
lat. 50[?] 25, long. 26 24[?], Bosphorus, bound W; 28th, 3:30 a. m., lat. 46 46,
long. 48 46, passed brig-rigged steamer bound W, supposed the Tripoli;
July 1, 2 p. m., 256 miles from Sandy Hook, saw steamship City of
New-York, The Queen, and City of Dublin.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted in lat. 44 40, long. 46 26 (19th inst.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Kangaroo (Br.), Manning, Liverpool June 9, via Queens
town the 10th, with mdse. and 554 pass. to John G. Dale. June 10,
16 miles W of Lattees[?], passed steamship Tripoli, bound in; 17th inst.,
in lat. 46 19, long. 41 36, British ship Kenelworth, bound W; 19th
inst., in lat. 44 40, long. 46 26, steamship Edinburgh, bound E; 21st
inst., in lat. 43 05, long. 56 50, ship American Congress, bound W; 22d
inst., in lat. 42 09, long. 61 48, a brig-rigged steamer, bound E.
